Delegations led by Smt. Anupriya Patel in her capacity as Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare
In the capacity of Hon’ble Minister of State for Health & Family Welfare, Smt. Anupriya Patel led a delegation to the Commonwealths of Dominica and Grenada from 8-17th May, 2018 under the ‘VRIHAD SAMPARK YOJANA’ of Ministry of External Affairs. It was the first Ministerial visit from India to these countries.
During her visit to Dominica from 11th to 12th May, 2018, she met the Hon’ble President, Hon’ble Prime Minister and Acting Minister of Foreign Affairs, Hon’ble Health Minister, Hon’ble Minister of Family and Gender Affairs of Dominican Republic and discussed the issues of importance between the two countries. While in Grenada during 13-14th May, 2018, she called on Shri Keith Mitchell, Hon’ble Prime Minister, Hon’ble Foreign Minister and Hon’ble Health Minister of Grenada and discussed areas of mutual interest to enhance overall cooperation between the two countries. While meeting the Hon’ble Prime Minister of Grenada, Smt. Anupriya Patel handed over a congratulatory letter from Shri Narendra Modi ji, Hon’ble Prime Minister of India.
During her visit to both the countries, the Hon’ble Minister met the Indian community and interacted with them.
Delegations led by Smt. Anupriya Patel ji in her capacity as Union Minister of State for Commerce & Industry
Greece during April 14-15, 2022:
As Hon’ble Minister of State for Commerce & Industry, Smt. Anupriya Patel led a delegation to Greece during April 14 – 15, 2022 to co-chair the 8th session of the India-Greece Joint Economic Committee meeting with Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Responsible for Economic Diplomacy and Openness, Kostas Fragkogiannis. During the meeting, a Protocol was signed by both the Ministers aimed at strengthening and further developing the economic and trade relations for mutual benefit of both the countries. A Memorandum of Understanding on Enhancing Bilateral Investment Relations between Invest India, National Investment Promotion and Facilitation Agency of India and Enterprise, Greece was also exchanged by both the Ministers.
Bangkok, Thailand during May 23-24, 2022:
Smt. Anupriya Patel led a delegation to Bangkok, Thailand during May 23-24, 2022 to attend the 78th session of the UNESCAP, which was also commemorating the 75th anniversary of its foundation. During the Ministerial segment of the 78th session of UNESCAP, the Hon’ble Minister delivered country statement on the theme, “A common agenda to advance sustainable development in Asia and the Pacific”.
Siem Reap City, Cambodia during September 16-17, 2022:
The Hon’ble Minister led another Indian delegation to Siem Reap City, Cambodia to co-chair the 19th ASEAN-India Economic Ministers’ Meeting along with H.E. Pan Sorasak, Minister of Commerce, Kingdom of Cambodia on 16th September, 2022 and to represent India in the 10th East Asia Summit Economic Ministers’ Meeting held on 17th September, 2022. The meeting saw representation from all 10 ASEAN countries as well as 8 partner countries viz. Australia, China, India, Japan, New Zealand, Republic of Korea, Russian Federation and the USA. The Ministers exchanged views on global and regional economic developments, including the outcomes of the 12th WTO Ministerial Conference, post-pandemic economic recovery efforts, measures adopted to mitigate the impact of global supply chain disruptions and strong inflationary pressure.
